system_description.narrative_title: Hot inflation fuels Fed-hike bets; yields spike and markets reprice
system_description.narrative_summary: Stronger-than-expected US inflation readings and hawkish comments from Fed officials have pushed market odds of further rate hikes higher, driving Treasury yields up (the 10-year back near/above 5%), strengthening the dollar and prompting equity and commodity repricing. The feedback loop between higher yields, tighter financial conditions and equity sell-offs is reshaping portfolio flows, pressuring cyclical assets and prompting central-bank reaction risk across advanced economies.
system_description.scope: Price inflation data (esp. US CPI), central-bank policy signalling (Fed and other major central banks), Treasury/bond yields and term structure, risk-asset (equity) and safe-haven (gold, dollar) price moves, market volatility and portfolio reallocation decisions by investors and institutions.
system_description.super_system: Global financial markets and the macroeconomic environment (global growth, inflation dynamics, and cross-border capital flows).
adjacent_subsystems: Currency and FX markets (dollar strength, yuan management)
Corporate sector capital allocation (buybacks, asset sales, earnings)
Sovereign debt and fiscal conditions (Treasury issuance, debt sustainability)
evidence_headlines: Hot U.S. inflation hasn’t cooled off. Rising consumer prices to keep Fed rate hike on track.
US consumer prices rise briskly for third straight month
Higher-than-expected October inflation sparks Treasury sell-off
10-year Treasury yield races back to 5% as inflation data, Waller comments drive rate hike expectations
Fed’s Waller puts half-point rate hike into the mix for December
Stocks fall as the 10-year Treasury yield reclaims 5%

variables.name: Consumer price inflation rate
variables.description: The continuous rate of change in broad consumer price indexes reflecting general inflation in goods and services.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: The market and public's aggregated expected future inflation over relevant horizons.

variables.name: Policy interest rate
variables.description: The prevailing short-term policy interest rate set by monetary authorities as commonly referenced in money markets.

variables.name: Monetary policy signal tone
variables.description: The aggregate hawkishness or dovishness of official communications and forward guidance about future policy actions.

variables.name: Short-term government yield
variables.description: The prevailing yield on short-maturity government debt instruments reflecting short-run rate expectations and liquidity.

variables.name: Long-term government yield
variables.description: The prevailing yield on long-maturity government debt instruments reflecting long-run inflation, growth expectations, and term premia.

variables.name: Yield curve term spread
variables.description: The differential between long-term and short-term government yields indicating expectations about future interest rates and growth.

variables.name: Risk-asset price level
variables.description: The aggregated price level of equity and other risk-sensitive assets reflecting valuation and sentiment.

variables.name: Safe-haven asset price level
variables.description: The aggregated price level of assets considered stores of value in stress (e.g., traditional safe havens) reflecting demand for safety.

variables.name: Market volatility
variables.description: The prevailing short-term volatility of financial asset returns as measured by option-implied or realized volatility metrics.

variables.name: Credit spread
variables.description: The average premium demanded over government yields for non-government credit, capturing perceived default and liquidity risk.

variables.name: Market liquidity
variables.description: The ease and depth with which financial assets can be transacted without large price impact.

variables.name: Portfolio reallocation flow rate
variables.description: The rate at which investors shift allocations across asset classes, geographies, or maturities.

variables.name: Net cross-border capital flow
variables.description: The net flow of capital across borders into or out of a currency area, measured per unit time.

variables.name: Household credit stock
variables.description: The outstanding nominal stock of household borrowing across credit products at a point in time.

variables.name: Government debt ratio
variables.description: The outstanding public debt stock measured relative to a macroeconomic denominator (e.g., GDP) indicating fiscal burden.

catalysts.title: Federal Reserve policy decision (December)
catalysts.description: FOMC decision in December that could raise the policy rate (including possibility of a 25–50bp hike) and update forward guidance.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Fed officials open door to half-point; Reuters poll and multiple stories point to a December hike.

catalysts.title: Next US consumer-price (CPI) release
catalysts.description: Monthly U.S. CPI report (November data) that will be read for inflation momentum and influence Fed expectations and market pricing.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines highlight upcoming CPI importance and that hot October inflation keeps markets on edge.

catalysts.title: Continued hawkish Fed commentary
catalysts.description: Ongoing series of hawkish public comments from Fed officials that raise the perceived odds of larger/earlier hikes and shift market pricing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Waller, Logan and other Fed officials publicly signal larger/earlier hikes after hot inflation prints.

catalysts.title: Other central banks continue tightening
catalysts.description: Near-term additional rate hikes or hawkish signals from major central banks (e.g., BoE, BoC) that reinforce global tightening expectations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Bank of England likely to join hikes; Bank of Canada signals more hikes and minutes show tightening rationale.

catalysts.title: Sustained 10-year Treasury yield at/above 5%
catalysts.description: Persistence of >~5% 10-year Treasury yields as markets reprice for higher terminal rates, pressuring risk assets and funding conditions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 10-year Treasury tops 5% and yields race back to 5% as hot inflation and Fed comments push rate expectations.

catalysts.title: Hedge fund position dumps and deleveraging
catalysts.description: Accelerated selling by hedge funds and liquidations that reduce liquidity, amplify volatility and pressure risk-asset prices.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: Exclusive — hedge funds dump positions and cut staff as selloff deepens, increasing market stress.
